verses.pali: … Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye labhanti tathāgataṁ dassanāya;
verses.english: … so too the sentient beings who get to see a Realized One are few,

verses.pali: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye na labhanti tathāgataṁ dassanāya.
verses.english: while those who don’t get to see a Realized One are many.
